top_signals.title: World’s Top LNG Buyer Doesn’t See Qatar Supply Coming Back Soon
top_signals.summary: The head of the world’s largest liquefied natural gas buyer expects disruptions to the Strait of Hormuz to persist, further curtailing flows from a region that accounted for about a fifth of global supply before the Middle East war.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
